name: Mouse Escape Tarkov
teaser: A simple plugin that lets you press a configurable key (default F11) to temporarily disable the mouse cursor locking so you can move you mouse out of the main Tarkov window. This is useful for multi-monitor setups.
description_html:
A simple plugin that lets you press a configurable key (default F11) to temporarily disable the mouse cursor locking so you can move you mouse out of the main Tarkov window. This is useful for multi-monitor setups.

This was created expressly to make playing on linux less unbearable. There are other tweaks to make things more stable in conjunction with this (I know I was getting some crashing before made some changes.) Check out the Github for a more detailed guide on some additional tweaks that may help stablaize Tarkov on Linux especially when using this plugin.

Warning. I wanted this quickly and was lazy because while I’ve worked with Harmony I’ve never done a BepInEx mod so I threw the request to ChatGPT and let it generate the actual code.
